verdict.rationale: Oyster is an HR/EOR SaaS platform, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows salary benchmarking data, a cost calculator, and automated reports, but nothing describes AI-generated insights or suggestions. These are adjacent features, not the capability itself. The llms.txt file is developer documentation formatted for LLMs, not an in-product AI feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
